_comment: Doug's own read on whether more sales are coming from an area — the one thing the survey export cannot know. lib/coverage.cjs measures intake direction from project starts, which says what HAS arrived; this file says what is expected to. Keyed by two-letter state, because that is the unit a sales crew moves in and the only key stable across clustering-radius changes. Written from the Resource page (Settings-style password, committed via api/update-outlook.js) or by hand. `flag` is one of growing | steady | winding_down | unknown, and a flag never changes a recommendation — it sits beside one, so a judgement call can never be mistaken for a measurement.
